title: Multi-SWT-Bench: A Multilingual Benchmark for Reproduction Test Generation
datasets: Multi-SWT-Bench-Lite/Flash: 340 tasks; used for every paper experiment
Source is Multi-SWE-Bench issues, filtered by golden reference test F2P validity
No Defects4J or BugsInPy experimental use
license: Zenodo CC BY 4.0; embedded package code Apache-2.0; upstream code and benchmark source retain their own terms; pinned MSWE-agent fork has unresolved license metadata
input_setting: Repository-level issue description + pre-fix code; produce tests only; score F2P and require all tests pass after golden patch
concept_hook: Issue-conditioned behavioral oracle via fail-before-fix/pass-after-fix; multilingual failure analysis around setup and test revisions
limitation: All experiments use 340-instance subset; hosted model aliases not pinned; Docker/multilingual setup is heavy; no Defects4J/BugsInPy experiment or causal bug taxonomy
